name: dbt
description: Supports two setup modes: (1) CLI-only with DBT_PROJECT_DIR and DBT_PATH for local dbt projects, or (2) dbt Platform with DBT_HOST and DBT_TOKEN for Discovery API, Semantic Layer, and Admin API access. Join #tools-dbt-mcp in the dbt Community Slack (https://www.getdbt.com/community/join-the-community) for support.
